scope: Forensically separate Realtime Voice function-call candidate dispatch, durable conversation-memory write authority, two-step task confirmation, downstream task execution, and cancellation semantics so Frankenstein-2.0 does not collapse voice intent, memory admission, task admission, and effect admission into one authority.

atoms.what_it_does: frank_erinnerung_schreiben validates only non-empty subject/value and then directly dispatches stern gespraech-erinnerung-schreiben with provenance label realtime-tool; it has no two-step user-confirmation state analogous to frank_auftrag_stellen.
atoms.why_it_exists: Persist selected spoken conversation content as Frankenstein's own durable conversation memory.
atoms.authority_class: persistent memory mutation path; must not be equated with verified world-fact authority
atoms.failure_mode: A model-selected memory statement can become durable without a typed evidence/admission distinction between user quote, model summary, inferred claim, instruction or verified fact.
atoms.concurrency_implication: No per-memory causal/admission identity is visible in this wrapper beyond downstream generated memory id and source label.
atoms.privacy_implication: Spoken content may be persisted; field-level retention/privacy policy is not enforced in this wrapper.
known_counterevidence: The write is constrained to a dedicated conversation-memory table downstream rather than arbitrary unified.db SQL; this narrows blast radius but does not establish epistemic admission.
open_questions: Define typed MemoryCandidate/MemoryAdmission classes and provenance so remembered conversation content cannot silently become canonical factual evidence.

atoms.what_it_does: frank_auftrag_stellen uses a mechanically enforced two-call proposal/confirmation state: exact normalized task text must match, at least one new server-transcribed microphone utterance must have arrived, proposal age must be <=300s, and explicit contradiction keywords veto execution; only then is the task sent to the asynchronous bridge.
atoms.why_it_exists: Prevent one misheard or isolated third-party utterance from immediately starting a real tool-capable task.
writes: asynchronous task queue on valid confirmation
atoms.authority_class: voice task-intent confirmation / task admission precursor, not downstream per-effect authority
atoms.failure_mode: The code explicitly admits that a second unrelated speaker utterance can still be misinterpreted as confirmation; there is no speaker verification or full intent classifier. A valid task confirmation also does not bind or preauthorize every downstream state-changing tool effect performed by the delegated worker.
atoms.concurrency_implication: One session-local _ausstehender_auftrag slot means overlapping proposals can replace/reshape the pending confirmation state; task confirmation identity is not a global immutable invocation capability.
atoms.privacy_implication: Intervening transcript text is retained in session memory for contradiction checks.
atoms.latency_or_cost_implication: Adds one explicit spoken roundtrip before dispatch.
atoms.state_lifetime: session-local proposal <=300 seconds, then asynchronous task lifetime
tests_or_receipts: donor source exposes test-bestaetigungsgate command, but this Triggerwort-5 run did not execute it
known_counterevidence: The mechanism intentionally narrows only a concrete voice-mishearing risk and is not claimed by its own source to solve multi-speaker attribution.
open_questions: Bind confirmed task intent to immutable task_admission_id/request_digest and keep downstream EffectDecision separate and executor-consumed.

atoms.what_it_does: Function calls emitted by the Realtime model are buffered; if response.done is non-completed, including cancelled barge-in cases, buffered calls are cleared and never locally dispatched. Only completed responses enter _tool_ausfuehren.
atoms.why_it_exists: Prevent a superseded/interrupted cognitive turn from executing a stale pending tool candidate.
atoms.failure_mode: Does not cancel or determine the outcome of an effect already submitted downstream; submitted effects require separate UNKNOWN/SUCCEEDED/FAILED outcome handling.
atoms.concurrency_implication: Pending tool calls are keyed by call_id inside one response/session map, which is stronger than the donor session-level active_turns.effect_id pattern for this pre-dispatch stage.
known_counterevidence: This is already represented in another Triggerword-5 control delta; included here only to establish the boundary with task/memory admission and must not receive duplicate credit.
open_questions: Unify pending candidate identity with typed PendingEffect without treating cancellation as a post-submission outcome.

atoms.what_it_does: Confirmed asynchronous task text is handed to gespraechsmodus.claude_frage with the current Claude session id and a berechtigung value; successful replies may replace the resumed Claude session id.
atoms.why_it_exists: Delegate tool-capable real work while keeping the low-latency Realtime voice session responsive.
writes: background task execution occurs outside this module
atoms.authority_class: task delegation boundary; exact downstream effect enforcement remains external and must be separately proven
atoms.failure_mode: Task confirmation can be mistaken for permission for all internal effects unless the delegated executor independently consumes typed EffectDecision per state-changing call.
atoms.concurrency_implication: Background bridge runs one thread per task while sharing a mutable resumed Claude session id reference; serialization/interleaving semantics require downstream audit.
atoms.privacy_implication: Task text is forwarded to the delegated Claude session.
atoms.latency_or_cost_implication: Runs asynchronously so voice remains nonblocking.
atoms.state_lifetime: background task plus resumed Claude-session lineage
known_counterevidence: This Triggerwort-5 run did not execute the delegated path; runtime reachability is source-derived from direct call wiring only.
open_questions: Inspect gespraechsmodus.claude_frage permission/host gate and prove per-effect decision consumption for downstream tools.

hypotheses: Frankenstein-2.0 needs four explicit boundaries: VoiceIntentEvidence -> TaskAdmission, MemoryCandidate -> MemoryAdmission, PendingEffect -> EffectDecision, and EffectOutcome/Reentry. None should imply another.
Conversation memory can remain useful and durable if persisted as typed provenance-bearing memory evidence/candidate rather than silently promoted to world fact.
The voice two-step gate is valuable as user-intent confirmation but should mint a bounded task_admission_id, not a blanket effect capability for delegated execution.
counterhypotheses: The dedicated gespraech_erinnerung table may be intentionally noncanonical enough that direct model-driven writes are acceptable if every read path treats entries only as remembered conversation claims. This must be proven end-to-end before retaining the current direct write.

gespraechsmodus.claude_frage or the host permission layer may already enforce each downstream effect independently, making task admission separation operationally adequate; exact source/runtime evidence is still required.
contradictions: TW5-CONTRADICTION-REALTIME-MEMORY-AUTHORITY-008 OPEN: Realtime model Function Calling can directly persist conversation memory, while current EntityOS authority law requires model outputs not to mint canonical truth. Resolution requires classifying this table/read path as typed noncanonical memory evidence or adding deterministic MemoryAdmission before persistence/promotion.

TW5-CONTRADICTION-TASK-VS-EFFECT-AUTHORITY-009 OPEN: voice confirmation mechanically gates task dispatch, but it is not an executor-consumed per-effect authorization and must not be reported as full EffectGate coverage.

TW5-CONTRADICTION-MULTISPEAKER-CONFIRMATION-010 OPEN: source explicitly acknowledges that unrelated second-speaker speech can satisfy the mechanical fresh-utterance condition if the Realtime model sets bestaetigt=true and no keyword veto fires.
critical_unknowns: Exact epistemic treatment of gespraech_erinnerung rows at every downstream retrieval/decision path: remembered quote/candidate versus factual truth.
Exact gespraechsmodus.claude_frage permission and host execution boundary after confirmed task dispatch.
Whether overlapping background voice tasks can safely share/resume one mutable Claude session lineage without causal cross-assignment.
Whether current host permission configuration covers every downstream state-changing tool and consumes immutable per-call EffectDecision.

recommended_next_spans.reason: Trace gespraech_erinnerung_schreiben storage schema plus all read paths to establish whether memory is evidence/candidate or is later treated as fact.
Trace claude_frage permission mode, process invocation, settings/host gates and downstream tool-effect authority.
Prove actual per-tool enforcement and wache/schranke ordering for delegated tasks.
Design typed MemoryCandidate/MemoryAdmission regression fixtures including user quote, model summary, inference, sensitive data and contradiction cases.
